turns.transcript: Hi, this is Jonas calling from Caffè Berlin.
We have a Marea 2 Plus, the Vaniglia edition.
The coffee comes out thin and fast, like water.

Last year we ordered the group gasket, the code is GE-2140. We also need the shower screen, GE-2150. For the heating element, heating element— the invoice says CA-1180. The control board is EL-3010, and the pump is ID-4010. The steam valve seal kit is VA-5015. In the other shop we have a Giglio 1 Plus and a Monda 65 Digit grinder, the burrs are MC-7010. And the Onda MB2 has a probe alarm.
